li.label: slaving in the fields
li.description: I'm bent over in the fields from dawn to dusk. My back is ruined.

li.label: harvest push
li.description: We're all out in the fields all day. My back aches.

li.label: good growing days
li.description: We're all out working the fields together. I like it.

li.label: a great harvest
li.description: We're all in the fields, and the crops look good. This is my kind of work.

li.label: hauling stone all day
li.description: I haul stone all day, every day. My hands are torn up.

li.label: building season
li.description: We're all on construction now. There's dust in my food and my bed.

li.label: raising walls
li.description: I like watching the new walls go up.

li.label: building something great
li.description: Every day the place gets bigger and better. I love it.

li.label: forced politeness
li.description: I have to smile and say thank you all day long. I'm about to snap.

li.label: best behavior
li.description: Minding my manners all day long. It's tiring.

li.label: a civil colony
li.description: We're all minding our manners. It's pleasant.

li.label: warmth all round
li.description: People say please and thank you around here now. I love it.

li.label: wasted mourning days
li.description: The work is piling up while we sit around grieving.

li.label: idle mourning
li.description: I respect the dead, but I'd rather honor them by working.

li.label: days of mourning
li.description: We stopped work to remember the dead. I'm glad we did.

li.label: grieving together
li.description: We all stopped to grieve together. I'm not alone with this.

li.label: constant alarm
li.description: Every shadow looks like a raider and every noise sounds like an attack. I can't take much more.

li.label: on guard
li.description: We keep weapons by the bed and sleep in shifts. I'm worn out.

li.label: ready for anything
li.description: Let them come. We're ready.

li.label: itching for a fight
li.description: We're all armed and waiting for a fight. I hope they come soon.

li.label: endless scrubbing
li.description: My hands are raw from scrubbing floors that were already clean.

li.label: clean sweep
li.description: It's mops and buckets all day. I'd rather be doing real work.

li.label: a clean colony
li.description: The place is clean, and fewer of us are getting sick.

li.label: spotless
li.description: Every floor is spotless. I can finally relax.

li.label: given a seat on the council
li.description: They chose me for the council. I'd better not make them regret it.

li.label: lost my seat
li.description: I had a seat on the council, and now they have it.

li.label: lost the vote to them
li.description: I should have won that seat. They got the votes instead.

li.label: that decree again
li.description: We only just got through that decree, and the council has ordered it again.

li.label: ashamed of our ways
li.description: This isn't the colony I wanted to belong to. I hear what people say about us, and they're right.

li.label: uneasy about our ways
li.description: I don't much like the way this colony is going.

li.label: like our ways
li.description: This colony does things the way I would.

li.label: proud of our ways
li.description: People know what this colony stands for. I'm proud to be part of it.
